items.title: Clayton Duerr Interview, 1972-04-17
items.q: I thought it was Ben Gussick, he played the drum, but I lost track of him

ctx.x: Wait, there was a, I thought it was Ben Gussick, he played the drum, but I lost track of him, but he was a, he played, I imagine he got to work with some pretty good band around New York after I left, but he was up and coming, I know that. He never heard of him much by name, but he probably worked some pretty good, but I'm on the station. I bet he got to be a house man somewhere or something. He was in with the clique, I know that. His name was Gussack.
